hideHidden.title: Hide hidden files
hideHidden.description: Leave out files and folders whose name starts with a dot (.env, .github, .claude). .git is never shown.

hideIgnored.title: Hide ignored files
hideIgnored.description: Leave out what git ignores (.gitignore: node_modules, dist, logs). When shown, they are dimmed.

openWith.title: Open with
openWith.description: Rules for a click in the tree: the first rule whose extensions match the file opens it; a file no rule matches opens in the project's file opener (the Reviewer). The right-click menu lists every matching rule. In a command, {file} is the file's path as one argument, a word of its own; for a pipe: sh -c 'glow "$1" | less -R' sh {file}. Commands run in the project folder, with no shell unless you name one.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: One or more, separated by spaces or commas: pdf, json jsonl, tar.gz

command.title: Command
command.description: For a terminal command, e.g. jq -C . {file}, or less {file}

waitForKey.title: Keep the output until Enter
waitForKey.description: After the command ends, wait for Enter before the overlay or tab closes. Turn off for programs that wait on their own (less, an editor).
